ACCESS_PANEL.title: Access Panel
ACCESS_PANEL.description: Allows access to panel interface. Useful for making VIP player type of permissions without any access.

MANAGE_SERVERS.title: Manage Servers
MANAGE_SERVERS.description: Can connect, disconnect, manage anything about a server.

MANAGE_POSTS.title: Manage Posts
MANAGE_POSTS.description: Can create, delete, publish a post and manage post categories.

MANAGE_TICKETS.title: Manage Tickets
MANAGE_TICKETS.description: Can reply, delete, close a ticket and manage ticket categories.

MANAGE_PLAYERS.title: Manage Players
MANAGE_PLAYERS.description: Can view, verify, delete, manage players. This does not include player's permissions!

MANAGE_VIEW.title: Manage View
MANAGE_VIEW.description: Can install, uninstall, change and manage a theme. This permission also allows for changing settings of a theme.

MANAGE_ADDONS.title: Manage Addons
MANAGE_ADDONS.description: Can install, uninstall, change and manage an addon. This permission also allows for changing settings of an addon.

MANAGE_PLATFORM_SETTINGS.title: Manage Platform Settings
MANAGE_PLATFORM_SETTINGS.description: Can edit website/platform settings. This permission also allows for checking and updating platform, addons and themes.

MANAGE_PERMISSION_GROUPS.title: Manage Permission Groups
MANAGE_PERMISSION_GROUPS.description: Can add, edit, delete a permission group. This permission also allows for change permission of a player with "manage players" permission.

ACCESS_ACTIVITY_LOGS.title: Access Activity Logs
ACCESS_ACTIVITY_LOGS.description: Can view activity logs. Caution: Activity logs may contain sensitive data.

MANAGE_TRANSLATIONS.title: Manage Translations
MANAGE_TRANSLATIONS.description: Can add, edit, delete translations and languages.
